runtime_support_notes: Vega-B master 1 spawns a delayed second slash through shared trigger LineAttack and linked on-hit status effect.
Shared OnKill effect deals a small slash using attack coefficient 0.5 and transfers 3 Name Mark stacks to the nearest enemy.
Vega-G passive: Vega-B hit applies 2 Name Mark stacks through triggered effect routing.
Vega-I passive: Vega-D hit applies 4s area-vulnerability debuff to the hit target.
Vega-I trait 2: routes the 6s variant of the Vega-D area-vulnerability debuff.
Vega-I passive: allied area damage charges Vega-D cooldown by 3% with 1 second ICD.
Vega-I trait 1: routes an additional +7% area-vulnerability debuff for 4s on Vega-D hit.
Vega-I trait 1 + trait 2: routes an additional +7% area-vulnerability debuff for 6s on Vega-D hit.
Vega-I trait 3: routes an additional Name Mark 10+ area-vulnerability debuff for 4s on Vega-D hit.
Vega-I trait 3 + trait 2: routes an additional Name Mark 10+ area-vulnerability debuff for 6s on Vega-D hit.
Vega-J passive: Vega-E kills refund 20% cooldown to all allied active skills.
Vega-J trait 1: Vega-E kills refund an extra 10% cooldown to all allied active skills.
Vega-J passive: if the Vega-E target survives the hit, apply 10% team damage taken debuff for 5s.
Vega-J trait 2: raises the surviving Vega-E target debuff to 15% for 5s.
Vega-J trait 3: Vega-E kills refund Vega-D cooldown by 20%.
